description: This file contains the implementation of the NoteEditorViewModel class which manages UI state and interactions for editing notes, including saving and deleting notes, in an Android app.

classes.name: NoteEditorUiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state of the Note Editor, primarily holding the current note.

classes.name: NoteEditorViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the logic for editing notes, including observing, saving, and deleting notes, with reactive UI state management.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new note or updates an existing one, then triggers the onDone callback.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current note if it exists, then triggers the onDone callback.
